Game Overview

At its heart, Gravity Break is a adventure game about defy gravity with your trusty jetpack in Gravity Break. Navigate a treacherous lab, dodging laser traps and rockets while collecting coins to enhance your escape plan. Harness power-ups to outsmart security and fly farther than ever. Can you outlast the odds and soar to freedom?
